mapper.insert: INSERT INTO charge_bonus_event ( event_name, event_type, bonus_rate, bonus_amount, min_charge_amount, max_bonus_amount, start_date, end_date, bonus_expire_days, status, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{eventName}, #{eventType}, #{bonusRate}, #{bonusAmount}, #{minChargeAmount}, #{maxBonusAmount}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{bonusExpireDays}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT event_seq AS eventSeq, event_name AS eventName, event_type AS eventType, bonus_rate AS bonusRate, bonus_amount AS bonusAmount, min_charge_amount AS minChargeAmount, max_bonus_amount AS maxBonusAmount, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, bonus_expire_days AS bonusExpireDays, status, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM charge_bonus_event WHERE event_seq = #{eventSeq}

SELECT event_seq AS eventSeq, event_name AS eventName, event_type AS eventType, bonus_rate AS bonusRate, bonus_amount AS bonusAmount, min_charge_amount AS minChargeAmount, max_bonus_amount AS maxBonusAmount, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, bonus_expire_days AS bonusExpireDays, status, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM charge_bonus_event WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND (start_date IS NULL OR start_date <= #{today}) AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= #{today}) AND (min_charge_amount IS NULL OR min_charge_amount <= #{chargeAmount}) ORDER BY bonus_rate DESC, min_charge_amount DESC

SELECT event_seq AS eventSeq, event_name AS eventName, event_type AS eventType, bonus_rate AS bonusRate, bonus_amount AS bonusAmount, min_charge_amount AS minChargeAmount, max_bonus_amount AS maxBonusAmount, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, bonus_expire_days AS bonusExpireDays, status, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM charge_bonus_event ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE charge_bonus_event SET event_name = #{eventName}, event_type = #{eventType}, bonus_rate = #{bonusRate}, bonus_amount = #{bonusAmount}, min_charge_amount = #{minChargeAmount}, max_bonus_amount = #{maxBonusAmount}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, bonus_expire_days = #{bonusExpireDays}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE event_seq = #{eventSeq}
UPDATE charge_bonus_event SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE event_seq = #{eventSeq}
